rules.description: Apron: allow WebSocket handshakes, connection status probes, upload writes, and live text
rules.expression: (http.host eq "server.apron.chat") and not (http.request.method in {"PUT" "OPTIONS"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/w/")) and not (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "OPTIONS"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/live/")) and (http.request.method ne "GET" or not http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/ws"} or (not any(lower(http.request.headers["upgrade"][*])[*] eq "websocket") and not any(http.request.uri.args["apron_connection_status"][*] eq "1")))

rules.description: Apron: the upload bucket serves only GET and HEAD of object keys, without a query string that would skip the cache
rules.expression: (http.host eq "media.apron.chat") and (not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or http.request.uri.query ne "" or not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/f/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/a/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/e/")))

rules.description: Apron: budget stop (the budget guard turns it on and off; leave it to the guard)
Apron: the upload bucket's files are never sniffed, so a text upload can't run as a script
Apron: stream write_url bodies to the Worker as they arrive (live text)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "server.apron.chat") and http.request.method eq "PUT" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/w/")

rules.description: Apron: send a browser opening the server as a page to the web client, with the server prefilled
rules.expression: (http.host eq "server.apron.chat") and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and not any(lower(http.request.headers["upgrade"][*])[*] eq "websocket") and not any(http.request.uri.args["apron_connection_status"][*] eq "1")

rules.description: Optional: limits / and /ws across ALL hostnames in the zone
